# Screen2Layers

> Reconstruct flat UI screenshots into movable slices and Figma-ready layered kits.

## Primary instructions

- SKILL.md: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/screen2layers/blob/main/SKILL.md
- Installation: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/screen2layers/blob/main/docs/install.md
- Update: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/screen2layers/blob/main/docs/update.md

## Install

`npx skills add Fable-Forge/screen2layers`
